transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I suppose I'm here because... well, things have just felt kind of quiet lately. The part of me that used to, I don't know, reach out to people or take pleasure in things... my work, yoga, galleries, even just journaling... it's just gone very quiet. I feel like I'm mostly just moving through obligations right now.
How long have you been feeling this way—weeks, months, or longer?
It's been... a while. Months, I suppose. Maybe about eight months. It started around the time my older relative moved into our apartment. Things just started shifting then.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep—trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up much earlier than usual—since this started?
Um... no, I don't think so. My sleep is mostly just... the same as always, I guess. I haven't really noticed any trouble with it.

Since your relative moved in about eight months ago, has your mood stayed pretty much the same low level the whole time, or does it get noticeably worse when you're dealing with issues related to them and lighter when you're not?
I don't know... it's just been pretty much the same. I haven't really noticed it changing based on... what's happening. Just... quiet. All the time.
Have you noticed feeling unusually tired or low on energy most days, even when you haven't been especially active?
Um... no, not really. I haven't noticed feeling more tired than usual. My energy is... it's fine, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to concentrate or make decisions—at work or elsewhere—since this started?
No... I don't think so. I can focus fine. Work is just... work. I haven't really had any trouble making decisions or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since this started—eating more or less than usual?
No, my appetite is... it's about the same. I just eat what I normally eat. I haven't noticed any weight changes either.
Before your relative moved in eight months ago, had you generally felt this kind of low mood or reduced enjoyment for a long time, or is this a new change for you?
I don't think so... I mean, I felt okay before. It's just recently, I guess. Everything was mostly normal before she moved in.
